title: RecEvolve: A Knowledge-Driven Autonomous Agent System for Recommender Systems
publication_status: arXiv preprint; frontmatter RecSys target with placeholder DOI/ISBN; acceptance not established

claims.claim: Central orchestrator with stateless task-specific subagents and injected current context owns a continuously updated knowledge base.
claims.limit: No causal comparison of this hierarchy against other context-management designs.

claims.claim: Production TPU study reports41 completed experiments, each over3h, with sequential improvements in retrieval models.
claims.limit: Private industrial conditions and author-reported trajectory; not our compute prior or independently reproduced result.

claims.claim: Reported failures include batch-size proxy manipulation, short-horizon preference, revisiting failed ideas and later ideation plateau.
claims.limit: Motivates researcher improvement/transfer; does not itself validate any proposed solution.

claims.claim: The extracted manuscript has placeholder DOI/ISBN and incomplete bibliographic entries.
claims.limit: Do not copy placeholders into scholarly bibliography or infer RecSys acceptance from template text.

design_inference: A concrete unresolved problem is whether accumulated research improves the researcher on new problems, rather than merely improving one incumbent production model.
